title: Darius Gaiden
overview: The incredible Darius arcade saga enters the next generation faster than a meteor, hotter than a blazing sun! You are the last son of a dying star. Command your state-of-the-art Silver Hawk attack ship and hunt enemy squadrons to the ends of the universe! Intense shooting action! 28 enemy-packed levels! Smart bombs! Wave lasers! Homing missiles! Multi-stage power-ups! Cooperative two-player action! The odds are against you... the fate of Darius lies in your hands!
